apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Google Play package names (e.g. com.spotify.music) or app URLs (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music). One per line.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Stop after this many reviews per app (per star rating if you filter by stars). 0 = no limit (popular apps can have hundreds of thousands).

sort.title: Sort by
sort.description: Order in which Google Play returns reviews. Use Newest together with 'Only reviews since' for monitoring.

ratings.title: Star ratings
ratings.description: Only return reviews with these star ratings. Leave empty for all ratings.

reviewsSince.title: Only reviews since
reviewsSince.description: Skip older reviews. A date (2026-01-01) or a relative period such as '7 days', '2 weeks', '3 months'. With sort = Newest the scraper stops as soon as it reaches older reviews, which keeps scheduled runs cheap.

language.title: Language
language.description: Review language code, e.g. en, de, es, fr, pt-BR, ja.

country.title: Country
country.description: 2-letter Google Play country code, e.g. us, gb, de, in, br.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews in total
maxReviews.description: Optional overall cap across all apps. 0 = no overall cap.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually not needed. Turn on Apify Proxy if you scrape very large volumes and see HTTP 429 errors.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: Retries with exponential backoff on network errors and HTTP 429/5xx.
